label: D1 after a2->S1 rewarded (rare), larger when belief favours S2 and trial before rewarded
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1)
explanation: Fires only at D1, and almost only when the previous trial was a2 -> S1 (rare) rewarded. That one indicator gives dev R^2 0.55 beyond timing. Within those trials the activation (about 1.6-2.0 when on) is larger when the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good is low (weight -1.2 on belief), i.e. when the rare reward goes against an S2-good belief, and larger when the trial before that was rewarded too (+0.53). With these three observed-only terms: dev 0.746, test 0.746 R^2 beyond timing, above the profile all/all-observed ceiling of 0.61. Graded belief_lo and belief do about equally well (0.70 dev). The state two trials back, belief_cover, ep_trial and a1 S1 r add little. GO and D2 are always zero. Compared with the model-output explanation, nothing is lost. A future-choice term (upcoming a2 after a2 S1 r) scores 0.69 dev, slightly worse than belief, so it was not recorded. Some misses remain: repeated a2 S1 r trials, where belief is already high for S1, still fire strongly.

issues: Minor: about 25% of the variance beyond timing is still unexplained. It is scattered, not systematic. Misses by phase x previous trial show residuals of only about -0.04 (D1, other patterns) and +0.013 (GO/D2).

Some worst-fit windows sit at the window's first trial, where the previous trial is unknown (actual 1.8 vs predicted 0.06). Edge terms ((phase==D1)*(trial==0) * in_rew * tv('action',0) * belief) add only about 0.001-0.002, so this class does not matter.
The feature sometimes fires at about 1.1-1.3 after a1 S1 r or a1 S2 r (seen in misses). An a1 S1 r term adds only 0.0008 on dev, so the claim that 'a1 S1 r adds little' holds.
As the explanation admits, after a2 S1 r trials where belief already favours S1 (e.g. actual 1.97 vs predicted 0.19) the belief term over-penalises. A belief^2 term does not fix this (0.7458).

Every claim checks out: indicator alone 0.548 dev; +belief 0.706; +reward(-2) 0.669; all three 0.7455 dev / 0.7459 test; belief_lo 0.744; upcoming-a2 version 0.689 dev; GO and D2 baselines are exactly zero.
